body: Use case: stylized-concept. Production body-only eight-direction car sprite sheet for Last on Grid, a grounded detailed hand-painted 2994 abandoned-world racing game. Original fictional Podmoss six-seat compact MPV, inspired only by the short wide tall packaging of a mid2000s European family MPV, NOT replica, NO logos or lettering. Sage olive green with cream roof and weathered terracotta patch panel. Short blunt bonnet, tall large-window cabin, unusual split-level small oval upper lights and lower rectangular lamps, rounded vertical tail lamps, five doors closed. Exact3:1 image,4columns2rows,8 equal cells: top front, front-right (nose points toward LEFT), right side (nose LEFT), rear-right (rear points RIGHT); bottom rear, rear-left (rear points LEFT), left side (nose RIGHT), front-left (nose RIGHT). All views match same body at equal scale, each whole body centered with padding. No wheels or tires; every wheel arch completely empty genuine transparent alpha through body, NO dark wheelwell backing. Transparent outside each body too. No ground shadows, scenery, people, grid, labels. Diffuse consistent lighting, subtle scrapes and rust, recognizable as roomy short family MPV not SUV.
dashboard: Use case: stylized-concept. Production cockpit foreground PNG for Last on Grid 2994 salvage racing. Original Podmoss compact wide six-seat family MPV interior, left-hand drive, sage green body/cream trim, detailed grounded semi-realistic hand-painted weathered charcoal dashboard with pale olive fabric inset and terracotta repair strip. Very wide2.5:1 image, driver-eye first person. Dashboard spans lower half, windshield opening completely transparent, no scenery or sky. Large empty dark recessed instrument display on LEFT behind steering position at x~26% width/y~75% height, sufficiently broad for runtime numeric speed RPM and gear; no drawn numbers or needles. Central raised pod with knobs and dash-mounted manual gear lever, broad practical shelves. No steering wheel at all (game overlays shared wheel at x~26% width bottom edge), no hands, no text, no logos, no badges. Keep main dashboard continuous all the way to bottom edge; large transparent windshield above. Warm subdued highlights, believable abandoned but drivable vehicle, gently worn not destroyed.
